provenance.label_use: Supervised ridge fit on old pilot60 labels; supervised selection on second-round96 labels; final-group labels/scores unused.
provenance.selection: No source native regression; source-macro native gain, rotation accuracy, negative NLL, negative delta norm; candidate order final tie-break.

fit_diagnostics.formula:
Build equal-source/question/option/rotation weighted normal equations.

For every gold-vs-wrong activation difference X, m=Xw. Questions wrong in
native order receive correction target max(0,1-m). Questions correct in
native order receive target zero for every comparison and rotation, softly
penalizing changes to their existing margins. Correct margins are not hard
constraints. The final radial norm cap is applied after the ridge solve.
fit_diagnostics.preservation: Zero correction targets penalize changes to all margins of native-correct fit questions; preservation is soft.

candidates.family: previous frozen PCA, relative to base L
